fix(postgres): preserve requested cancellation receipt

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-43
  description: |-
    Return the original requested cancellation receipt even after the Attempt becomes terminal, so replay behavior remains independent of lifecycle timing, command ID, and stale expected versions.
    
    Add PostgreSQL acceptance coverage for request, terminalization, restart-style replay with a different command, and retention of the cancelled Attempt state.
